briarwatch.name: Briarwatch
briarwatch.subtitle: The Bell & Bramble
briarwatch.description: Rain taps the inn’s copper awning. Smith Dera keeps a place for your party beside the forge, and Reeve Aveline pins reports from the wider roads to a public board.
briarwatch.rumor: The missing caravans did not simply vanish. A western tollhouse has been ringing the wrong road signal.

ashford.name: Ashford Crossing
ashford.subtitle: The Three Roads Market
ashford.description: River barges unload beneath a bridge crowded with petitioners. Quartermaster Iona offers contracts, while merchants argue over who should pay to repair the region’s wards.
ashford.rumor: Sabotage at the western span and poison in the marsh share the same copper dust. Someone is moving ward machinery downstream.

highpass.name: Highpass Watch
highpass.subtitle: The Last Warm Hearth
highpass.description: The outpost’s lamps swing in the mountain wind. Captain Sorrel has room for refugees but not another failed expedition. Beyond the parapet, stormlight threads the old signal towers.
highpass.rumor: The final beacon does not need a new master. The old wardens designed it to answer a council of voices, not a single command.
